issues_in: Status wording tension: `status_as_of_cutoff` asserts Glendale "approved a pre-annexation development agreement on 2026-04-28", but the matching action (2026-04-28) and NOTES.md on
fixed: data.json: rewrote `status_as_of_cutoff` so the Glendale item reads "Glendale City Council's 2026-04-28 agenda indexed Resolution R26-42 for a pre-annexation development agreement, but adoption of the resolution was not verified in the fetched record" (no longer asserts Glendale "approved" the agreement; aligns with the 2026-04-28 action and NOTES.md).

data.json: added a dated history entry (2026-08-11, field status_as_of_cutoff) whose previous_value is the pre-fix wording and whose reason documents the evidence basis (agenda/video index item only, adoption not verified).

data.json: updated the 2026-04-28 action's access_caveat to record that the swagit video page (https://glendaleaz.new.swagit.com/videos/384335) returned 403 during the 2026-08-10/11 refresh but re-check on 2026-08-11 returned HTTP 200 with R26-42 listed under consent resolutions; kept the procedural-evidence-only caveat.

NOTES.md: appended a dated 2026-08-11 fix-pass note to the 2026-08-11 section documenting the wording alignment, the verified HTTP 200 re-check (agenda index lists R26-42 as consent resolution item 28, "authorizing and directing the entering into of a pre-annexation development agreement with Baccara Eagle Land, LLC..."), and the source URLs.
remaining_risks: The issue string in scratch/fix/inventory.json is truncated mid-sentence (ends "...and NOTES.md on"); the fix was scoped to the clear subject of the sentence: the Glendale 2026-04-28 "approved" wording vs. agenda-index-only evidence.

Adoption of Resolution R26-42 (final vote/minutes) is still not independently verified; the swagit page places it on the consent agenda, which is acted on by one motion, but no signed minutes were fetched. The Glendale Laserfiche resolution page (https://docs.glendaleaz.com/WebLink/DocView.aspx?dbid=0&id=7485974&repo=City-of-Glendale) remains session-limited (unchanged from refresh).
Other URL statuses in sources were not re-checked this pass; only the URL implicated by the issue was re-verified.
summary: Fixed the single status/evidence wording mismatch for USDC-0085: status_as_of_cutoff no longer asserts Glendale approved the pre-annexation development agreement on 2026-04-28; it now states the council agenda indexed Resolution R26-42 with adoption unverified, matching the action and NOTES.md. A history entry and NOTES.md fix-pass note document the change, and a web re-check confirmed the swagit video page is live (HTTP 200) listing R26-42 under consent resolutions. data.json validated as JSON after every edit.
